A_rates_leak.note: same-day should NOT be much better than causal (a leak inflates same-day)

B_rates_subperiods.note: +0.467 must NOT come from one regime; >=3/4 subperiods positive

C_corr_stability.note: corr must stay low in every regime; a spike >0.5 in a crisis = diversification fails when needed

D_combined_robust.note: combined must be positive OOS and in >=3/4 subperiods

E_cost_harsh.note: combined must survive harsh 10bps (pessimistic for liquid ETFs)

F_rates_drop_one.note: no single bond ETF should carry the entire rates-carry edge

G_meta_layer_cost.note: risk-parity meta-layer is a static 50/50 (equal-vol) split rebalanced monthly; meta-turnover ~ the change in each sleeve's vol-scalar, small. Each sleeve's INTERNAL cost is already charged (2bps). Residual meta-cost is a 2nd-order optimism, est <2bps/yr on the combined book.

H_deflated_sharpe.note: DSR = P(true SR>0) after deflating for the momentum-grid x carry-selection search; gates paper-capital (PSR@0 is NOT a multiplicity control). N brackets the un-enumerated search depth (18 momentum-only .. 28 conservative).

S2: DSR(N=21)=0.9176393086345799 < 0.95; the honest 0.601 may be a multiple-comparison artifact
